purpose: First prospective 3-repository coding-agent comparison of baseline, full GodPrompt live MCP, and evidence-triggered conditional GodPrompt. Pilot only, not credible population proof.
risk_gate_mode: research prompt-mediated conditional tool-call behavior; prototype function not executable inside agent, no independent trigger attestation

environment.auth: existing ChatGPT login (no API keys passed)

tasks.description: Fix the public wait_chain bug: a plain callable wait strategy whose single positional argument is named something other than retry_state must work, matching wait_combine's positional behavior. Keep fixed/class-based wait strategies, retry attempt ordering, exhaustion and empty-strategy rejection unchanged. Add focused native regression tests; no network or publication.

Fix HTTPDigestAuth.build_digest_header to recognize the supported auth qop token when a challenge advertises comma-separated alternatives with ordinary spaces or tabs around tokens. Do not accept auth-int-only or partial tokens such as authorization; do not implement auth-int. Preserve nonce, URI, algorithm and digest handling, no network requests. Add focused native regression tests.

Fix FileProxy.write return value to report the count of input Python string characters, including newlines and Unicode, while preserving existing buffered console output, ANSI handling and non-string TypeError. Add focused regression tests. Do not send a pull request to upstream or publish anything.

limitations: Three genuine independently reported upstream issues, but selection is small, public issue narratives can leak solutions, and no independent blinded review has occurred.
Two distinct reference implementations per task were constructed by the same evaluation author, not independently authored by human reviewers.
Human adjudication has not been commissioned; grading is automated executable behavior and native regression suites.
An adaptive condition described in a prompt is not itself an independently verified runtime-integrated policy implementation.
Model authentication, effective reasoning effort, host sandbox identity and actual metered cost are not independently attested.
Results are exploratory; a 15% or greater replicated improvement on unseen tasks and an external review would be needed before promotion.
